cohort: The study participants included 21 pregnant women who had a laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, from whom placental specimens were collected.
finding: The study found positive SARS-CoV-2 virions in 15 placentas, including those from cases of spontaneous preterm birth and intrauterine fetal demise, and demonstrated in vitro infectivity of trophoblast cells by SARS-CoV-2.
